decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered the list for actual backpacks, as several items in the feed were miscategorized (tents, towels, lanterns). My consideration set included two sports-specific bags (DeMarini and Rawlings), a premium tactical bag (Maxpedition), a popular hydration pack (Mubasel Gear), and a versatile sling bag (TUDEQU). I ultimately chose the Mubasel Gear Hydration Backpack because its extremely high volume of positive reviews (over 10,000) and 4.6 rating suggest high reliability for its price point. It meets my needs for an outdoor-ready backpack that provides functional value with its included 2L bladder and cooling properties.
